# Review run, validation after later fixes

A later editing Step changed the reviewed head. Repeats repository final validation and extra commands before Delivery, and appends the results to the comment.

```
Validate the final Review run worktree for pull request <pull request URL> at commit <own head>. A later editing Step changed the head after the Code review's validation. Change no tracked files, refs or index; do not commit, push, fix findings, edit the pull request or post comments. Disposable validation artifacts are allowed. Do not read private Security reports or include Security finding details in this report.
Do not fetch pull request or issue comments.
Validation instructions: run final validation as required by the repository's agent instructions in this Review run's worktree. Also run every extra shell command in this JSON list, in order, in that worktree: []. An empty list still requires the repository's final validation. A failed command must not skip the remaining commands. Keep disposable validation logs inside the worktree, never in `/tmp`, so worktree cleanup can remove them. Do not re-run full test suites with `--debug` or verbose trace flags to isolate a failure; re-run the failing test file or filter instead. Inspect large logs with bounded streaming tools (`tail`, `head`, `grep`) rather than reading entire files into memory. If the repository's agent instructions say a suite is invalid from a worktree, do not run it elsewhere as a substitute: report it as `not run against the branch`, with the reason, and never report it as passing. In the final report that thirdshift posts as the review comment, list each exact command and what ran, what passed, what failed and what could not run, with exit status or the reason it could not run. Check the pull request is still open at most once, immediately before starting a multi-minute validation suite; stop if it is merged or closed. Do not poll PR state before targeted checks, file reads or sub-agent steps; thirdshift checks lifecycle around the session and before Delivery.
Return only the complete validation results for this head. Delivery appends them to the review comment.
You run headless: nobody is watching, and ending your turn ends the session. Run tests and other long commands in the foreground, raising the command's timeout if needed. If a command is moved to the background, wait for that task by its own task id or output file, never by process names or patterns (`pgrep`, `ps | grep`, and the like): other sessions on this machine run the same commands. Never end your turn while a background task you depend on is still running: ending the turn kills it. Before ending your turn, stop every background task you no longer need, by its task id (with the `TaskStop` tool, if you have it): a task still running when your turn ends is taken as work you were waiting on. thirdshift records this session as a Session trace, with Model evidence and any review reports beside it.
```
